title: HALO-Flight strengthens Texas-based air med Fleet with additional Bell 407GXi purchase order
summary: This aircraft marks the seventh instrument flight rules-equipped Bell 407GXi to soon join the HALO fleet.
body_markdown:
Bell Textron Inc. announced during the annual Air Medical Transport Conference (AMTC) 2026 the purchase order for a Bell[407GXi](https://helitrader.com/for-sale/helicopters/bell/407gxi) to HALO-Flight, further expanding the ability to deliver rapid, life-saving air medical transport to patients across South Texas.


This aircraft marks the seventh IFR-equipped Bell[407GXi](https://helitrader.com/for-sale/helicopters/bell/407gxi) to soon join the HALO fleet, enhancing reliability and providing time-sensitive care across the region.


“HALO-Flight’s work across South Texas calls for reliable, high-performing aircraft,” said Lane Evans, managing director, North America, Bell. “We are proud to support their mission with our aircraft built around reliability, safety and performance. The Bell[407GXi](https://helitrader.com/for-sale/helicopters/bell/407gxi) provides the power and safety that air medical crews count on every day.”


Brent Bundy Photo


HALO-Flight is a nonprofit air medical provider dedicated to providing life-saving air medical transport to the communities of South Texas, regardless of a patient’s ability to pay.


Serving 23 counties across approximately 24,000 square miles, HALO-Flight operates around the clock, responding to emergency scenes and interfacility transports to bring critical care to patients when and where it’s needed most.


“Bell has been a trusted friend, mentor and business partner to HALO-Flight for decades,” said Travis Patterson, CEO, HALO-Flight. “As we enter our 40th year of service and continue growing to meet the needs of South Texas, we’re grateful to continue that relationship with a fellow Texas organization that has supported our mission and helped keep HALO-Flight flying for generations.”


To find out more about how the Bell[407GXi](https://helitrader.com/for-sale/helicopters/bell/407gxi) advances missions worldwide, visit the Bell product[page](https://www.bellflight.com/products/bell-407) , or stop by Bell at booth #617 during[AMTC 2026.](https://www.bellflight.com/events/amtc)


*This press release was prepared and distributed by Bell.*
